components.name: Start Part

components.css: .ds-part-go { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 14px; font: inherit; font-weight: 800; color: var(--ink, #1b1b1f); border: 2.5px solid var(--ink, #1b1b1f); border-radius: var(--radius-part, 18px); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); background: var(--play, #2fb457); box-shadow: inset 0 -7px 0 color-mix(in oklab, var(--play, #2fb457) 72%, black), var(--drop, 0 7px 16px -6px rgb(27 27 31 / 0.38)); width: 100%; height: 84px; font-size: 2.1rem; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-part-go svg { width: 1.1em; height: 1.1em; fill: var(--ink, #1b1b1f); } .ds-part-go:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-part-go:active { transform: translateY(4px); box-shadow: inset 0 -3px 0 color-mix(in oklab, var(--play, #2fb457) 72%, black), 0 2px 6px -3px rgb(27 27 31 / 0.4); } .ds-part-go:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ink, #1b1b1f); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Reset Part

components.css: .ds-part-reset { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 14px; font: inherit; font-weight: 800; color: var(--ink, #1b1b1f); border: 2.5px solid var(--ink, #1b1b1f); border-radius: var(--radius-part, 18px); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); background: var(--paper, #ffffff); box-shadow: inset 0 -7px 0 color-mix(in oklab, var(--paper, #ffffff) 72%, black), var(--drop, 0 7px 16px -6px rgb(27 27 31 / 0.38)); width: 100%; min-height: 64px; padding: 10px 20px; font-size: 1.1rem; justify-content: flex-start; } .ds-part-reset svg { width: 1.1em; height: 1.1em; fill: var(--ink, #1b1b1f); } .ds-part-reset:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-part-reset:active { transform: translateY(4px); box-shadow: inset 0 -3px 0 color-mix(in oklab, var(--paper, #ffffff) 72%, black), 0 2px 6px -3px rgb(27 27 31 / 0.4); } .ds-part-reset:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ink, #1b1b1f); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-part-reset svg { fill: none; stroke: var(--ink, #1b1b1f); stroke-width: 2.6; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }

components.css: .ds-tab-rail { display: flex; gap: 10px; padding: 14px 20px 0; background: var(--page, #cfe6f5); border-bottom: 6px solid var(--play, #2fb457); } .ds-tab { --tab-hue: var(--play, #2fb457); flex: 1; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; height: 54px; padding: 0 12px; font: inherit; font-size: 1.08rem; font-weight: 800; color: var(--ink, #1b1b1f); background: var(--paper, #ffffff); border: 2.5px solid var(--ink, #1b1b1f); border-bottom: 0; border-radius: 16px 16px 0 0; cursor: pointer; transform: translateY(6px); transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), background-color 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-tab--buttons { --tab-hue: var(--buttons, #f7c625); } .ds-tab--tune { --tab-hue: var(--tune, #ff8a3d); } .ds-tab-icon { width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: 9px; border: 2px solid var(--ink, #1b1b1f); background: var(--tab-hue); } .ds-tab:hover { transform: translateY(2px); } .ds-tab[aria-selected="true"] { background: var(--tab-hue); transform: translateY(0); } .ds-tab[aria-selected="true"] .ds-tab-icon { background: var(--paper, #ffffff); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ink, #1b1b1f); outline-offset: -7px; }

components.css: .ds-steps { list-style: none; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 10px; padding: 0; margin: 0; } .ds-chip { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; height: 46px; padding: 0 12px 0 6px; border: 2px dashed rgb(27 27 31 / 0.4); border-radius: 999px; color: var(--ink-soft, #414852); font-weight: 700; } .ds-chip-num { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 32px; height: 32px; border: 2px solid currentColor; border-radius: 50%; font-weight: 800; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-chip--done { border-style: solid; border-color: var(--ink, #1b1b1f); color: var(--ink, #1b1b1f); } .ds-chip--done .ds-chip-num { background: var(--ink, #1b1b1f); color: var(--paper, #ffffff); border-color: var(--ink, #1b1b1f); } .ds-chip--current { background: var(--paper, #ffffff); border: 2.5px solid var(--ink, #1b1b1f); color: var(--ink, #1b1b1f); transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 7px 16px -6px rgb(27 27 31 / 0.38); } .ds-chip--current .ds-chip-num { background: var(--ink, #1b1b1f); border-color: var(--ink, #1b1b1f); color: var(--paper, #ffffff); }

components.name: Keycap Select

components.css: .ds-keycap { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 178px; height: 56px; padding: 0 34px 4px 14px; font-weight: 800; background: var(--buttons, #f7c625); color: var(--ink, #1b1b1f); border: 2.5px solid var(--ink, #1b1b1f); border-radius: 13px; box-shadow: inset 0 -6px 0 color-mix(in oklab, var(--buttons, #f7c625) 70%, black), 0 5px 10px -5px rgb(27 27 31 / 0.4); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-keycap:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-keycap:active { transform: translateY(3px); } .ds-keycap:focus-within { outline: 3px solid var(--ink, #1b1b1f); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-keycap-chevron { position: absolute; right: 9px; top: calc(50% - 12px); width: 20px; height: 20px; fill: none; stroke: var(--ink, #1b1b1f); stroke-width: 3; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-keycap select { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; opacity: 0; font-size: 16px; cursor: pointer; appearance: none; }

narrative.overview:
The window is a page from a toy's assembly booklet: a sky-blue sheet, white callout boxes ruled in black ink, chunky plastic parts you press, and monumental step numerals that tell a child where they are without asking them to read. The reader is a child operating a gamepad alone, so pictures, colour and a few heavy words carry the meaning; a grown-up finds button mapping and tuning behind the other two tabs, drawn in the same booklet language rather than a separate "settings" look.

Density is low and deliberate. One stage callout fills the first viewport with one numeral, one controller drawing, one sentence and one full-width part to press. Everything is outlined in the same ink line, so the page reads like printed line art with colour dropped only into the parts that can be pressed. The system explicitly refuses the dark settings-utility look: no dark chrome, no status pills, no bare native form controls. Sliders and dropdowns exist, but only dressed as toy parts.
keyCharacteristics: Sky-blue page, white paper callouts, near-black ink outlines on everything.
Saturated hue appears only on pressable parts; each tab owns one hue.
Pressable parts are moulded plastic with an inset bottom lip that compresses on press.
One heavy weight (800) for anything that names a thing; soft ink at 500 for help text.
A single line-art controller drawing is the recurring illustration, reused at every scale.
Layout never shifts when state changes; panels and slots are pre-sized.

rules.name: The Pressable Hue Rule
rules.body: Saturated colour (play, buttons, tune, stop) lands only on parts you can press, or on the drawn controller button a part refers to. Surfaces, text and frames stay page, paper and ink.

rules.name: The One Hue Per Section Rule
rules.body: Each tab owns one hue, exposed as the current section hue. The selected tab fills with it and the 6px rail under the tabs takes it, so the whole frame says which section you are in.

rules.name: The Never Colour Alone Rule
rules.body: Every colour state has a shape partner: done steps get an ink tick, upcoming steps are dashed, the current step is raised and solid, Start and Stop carry play and stop glyphs.

rules.name: The Heavy Name Rule
rules.body: Anything that names a thing or an action is 800 in full ink. Anything that explains is 500 to 700 in soft ink. There is no middle tier.

rules.name: The Short Words Rule
rules.body: Copy is a single sentence or a word or two. If a label needs a paragraph, it belongs on the grown-up tabs, not the stage.

rules.name: The Pre-Sized Stage Rule
rules.body: All three step panels occupy the same grid cell, so the stage is always as tall as its tallest panel. The waiting slot in step 1 and the Start part in step 2 share the same height, so changing steps never moves anything on the page.

rules.name: The Plastic Lip Rule
rules.body: Only pressable parts get the inset lip, and the lip is always derived from the part's own hue. A lip on a non-pressable surface is a lie about what can be pressed.

rules.name: The One Drop Rule
rules.body: There is one drop shadow. Do not invent stronger or coloured shadows for emphasis; emphasis comes from hue and size.

dos: **Do** outline every surface and part in ink (2.5px standard, 2px secondary); a shape without an ink line does not belong in the booklet.
**Do** keep saturated hue on pressable parts only, and take a new section's colour from the current section hue so the tab, rail and its parts agree.
**Do** give every pressable part the plastic lip in a darker mix of its own hue, the 1px hover lift and the 4px press.
**Do** pair every colour state with a shape: tick, dash, glyph, numeral or raised position.
**Do** pre-size anything that changes state (stage panels, waiting slot vs Start part, fixed-height chips and keycaps) so no state change moves the layout.
**Do** draw new illustration as ink line art on the existing controller drawing, and show "which button" with a magnifier crop rather than a name.
**Do** style only through classes and the root custom properties; the app runs under a strict content security policy with no inline styles.
**Do** keep tap targets large: 46px minimum for chips and fixed keycaps, 54px and up for tabs and parts.
donts: **Don't** build dark chrome, status pills or bare native controls; state lives in the step strip and the stage, and sliders and pickers are always dressed as toy parts.
**Don't** put saturated colour on backgrounds, text or decoration that cannot be pressed.
**Don't** add a second typeface or a mid weight for names; names are 800, explanation is 500 in soft ink.
**Don't** invent new shadows; use the one drop and the plastic lip.
**Don't** use Minecraft, Mojang, Xbox or PlayStation logos, colours or lettered face-button trade dress anywhere in the drawing or UI.
**Don't** use Faint Ink for readable text; it is for the asleep drawing only.
